title: Passage: In the villa
standardSummary: Read a short 1st-declension passage with sum; answer who/where questions and translate one sentence.
teach: Read continuous Latin: subjects with est/sunt and place with in + abl.

seeds.prompt: According to the passage, where is the girl?

passage.title: In the villa
passage.latin:
Puella in villā est.
Fēmina quoque in villā est.
Aqua in mēnsā est.
Puellae sunt laetae.
passage.notes: villa = country house · mēnsa = table · laetae = happy (f. pl.) · Use known vocabulary; guess from context only if needed.
